# Los Angeles (LOX) — the NWS forecast in plain English

> Area Forecast Discussion · National Weather Service Los Angeles (LOX).

This is the National Weather Service's own discussion with its shorthand expanded — no AI summary, no editing. Discussions are reissued 3 to 4 times a day.

---

Full edition, with the AI plain-English summary beside the annotated original: [https://plaincast.live/o/LOX/](https://plaincast.live/o/LOX/)

Source: [National Weather Service](https://www.weather.gov) Los Angeles (LOX). Every office: [/sitemap.xml](https://plaincast.live/sitemap.xml). RSS: `https://plaincast.live/api/feed?office=LOX`.
